name: The Royal Wedding Planner
source:
You're planning the royal wedding of the century... but when love isn’t on the guest list, will you end up falling for one of the two that is supposed to say "I do"? It’s up to you!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Royal_Wedding_Planner]Choices Wikia[/url]]
